newsitem.title: THAILAND: Big C sees strong profit rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Big C sees strong profit rise in 1997.

text.p: Big C Supercenter Plc said on Friday it expected net profit to rise to 295 million baht in 1997 from a projected 154 million this year.
Big C managing director Preecha Ekkunnagul said in an interview his company plans to double the size of its supermarket chain to 22 stores by the end of 1997 from 11 at the end of this year.
He said seven of the company's planned 22 stores will be located in Bangkok and its satellite towns.
Preecha said the expanded chain would double Big C's gross sale revenue to about 20 billion baht in 1997 from an estimated 10 billion this year. -- Bangkok newsroom (662)-2629950-3
